defects.title: Executable signer-first AI/ML protocol verification is missing
defects.observed_behavior: Current PSTF evidence maps criteria to placeholder tests only; no executable tests prove AI/ML command/result kinds, read-model addressability, correlation tags, or HTTP-polling avoidance.
defects.intended_behavior: Signer-first AI/ML protocol readiness requires deterministic event-driven tests and production code evidence for the declared event semantics.
acceptance_criteria: Executable tests cover 38390-38399 command/result events and 31980-31989 read models.
Tests verify required e, p, status, d, correlation, and scoped tags.
Tests verify OK, CLOSED, AUTH, EOSE, validation, and no HTTP polling for long-running completion.
